rubric.name: Refactoring follow-ups close
criteria: Assess whether the twelve issue dispositions and eight phase records support the proposed delegated close. Prioritize material contradictions, missing gates or residuals without owners or triggers.
Evaluate the scope of the compatibility, portability and test claims against the measured results. Distinguish phase review, reviewed versions, repairs, and the owner ruling. Cite the specific text.
Review the three supplied artifacts as a focused pass. Do not run builds or tests, change files, or delegate.
